name: bigram probability ordering
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=2)
model.train("ababa")
prob_b = model.prob("a", "b")
prob_a = model.prob("a", "a")
assert prob_b > prob_a >= 0.0
assert math.isclose(prob_a + prob_b, 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)
unseen_total = model.prob("z", "a") + model.prob("z", "b")
assert math.isclose(unseen_total, 0.0, abs_tol=1e-9) or math.isclose(unseen_total, 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)

name: unigram probabilities and perplexity
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=1)
model.train("aab")
prob_a = model.prob("ignored", "a")
prob_b = model.prob("ignored", "b")
assert prob_a > prob_b > 0.0
assert math.isclose(prob_a + prob_b, 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)
score = model.perplexity("ab")
assert math.isfinite(score)
assert score >= 1.0

name: uses the last n minus one context characters
test:
model = NGramCharModel(n=3)
model.train("ababa")
assert model.prob("xxab", "a") > model.prob("xxab", "b")
assert model.prob("ba", "b") > model.prob("ba", "a")

name: seeded top-k sampling excludes lower-ranked characters
test:
import random
model = NGramCharModel(n=1)
model.train("aaabbc")
random.seed(7)
samples = [model.sample_top_k("", k=2) for _ in range(300)]
assert set(samples) <= {"a", "b"}
assert "a" in samples
assert "b" in samples

name: k larger than vocabulary samples from all known characters
test:
import random
model = NGramCharModel(n=1)
model.train("ab")
random.seed(11)
samples = [model.sample_top_k("", k=10) for _ in range(50)]
assert set(samples) <= {"a", "b"}
assert set(samples) == {"a", "b"}

name: untrained and out-of-vocabulary behavior
input: untrained model and an unseen next character
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=2)
assert model.prob("", "a") == 0.0
assert math.isinf(model.perplexity("abc"))
model.train("abc")
score = model.perplexity("abc")
assert math.isfinite(score)
assert score >= 1.0
assert math.isinf(model.perplexity("az"))

name: end-to-end character model workflow
input: train and evaluate a small repeated corpus
test:
import math
import random
text = "to be or not to be, that is the question. " * 20
model = NGramCharModel(n=4)
model.train(text)
score = model.perplexity(text)
assert math.isfinite(score)
assert score >= 1.0
random.seed(13)
samples = [model.sample_top_k("to be", k=10) for _ in range(50)]
assert set(samples) <= set(text)
